title: Use actual circuit normalization rather than free coefficient dynamics
statement: Deleting a discarded wire from a junk permutation gives coefficient1 when it was fixed and1/r otherwise, with the same logical partial trace and survivor order. Each surviving permutation has four predecessors. The exact six-coefficient transfer retains logical/reference correlations and supports a finite group readout for a specified physical circuit. General S4 source-input expansions require actual staged Stinespring normalization; the simpler pre-query subgroup normalization cannot be transplanted without its premise.
